contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman radiate of Carausius (AD 286-293), dating to AD 286-293 (Reece Period 14). [PAX] A[VG] reverse type depicting Pax standing left holding a branch and a transverse sceptre. Mint unclear. Possibly an irregular copy. The coin has been overstruck on a coin of Tetricus I-II (AD 271-274). On the obverse the Tetricus undertype is partially visible with the spikes of Tetricus' crown…
